concerns.text: Missing task for SC-004 (Peak memory usage during training). While T008 and T008a address memory logic and integration testing, there is no explicit task to implement the runtime enforcement of the 7GB limit during the actual training loop (T018b) as mandated by SC-004. T018b mentions dynamic reduction but lacks a dedicated task to implement the monitoring and enforcement mechanism required to satisfy the success criteria.

Missing task for SC-003 (Inference time < 100ms). Task T036b verifies the constraint via a benchmark, but there is no task to implement the actual inference logic or the optimization required to ensure the model meets this latency target. The plan assumes the model will naturally meet this, but no implementation task exists to build the inference engine or optimize the graph traversal for speed.

Missing task for SC-005 (Feature importance p-values). Task T027d enforces the gate (count < 3), and T023/T024 calculate p-values, but there is no explicit task to implement the statistical aggregation logic that combines SHAP and permutation results into a unified significance metric as required to 'identify' the descriptors. The aggregation logic is implied in T027a but not explicitly scoped to satisfy the 'at least 3 descriptors' success criteria.

Stale/Conflicting Tag: Task T021b is listed twice. First as 'T021b [US2] Inter-Family Validation Gate' (unmarked checkbox) and later as 'T021b [US2] Implement metrics aggregation...' (checked). The second instance has the same ID but different content and status, creating a duplicate ID conflict that breaks traceability.
